8 Days 7 Nights Wildebeest Migration Group Joining Safari

Package overview

Maasai Mara National Reserve – Lake Nakuru National Park – Lake Naivasha – Amboseli National Park Experience the thrill of Kenya’s most iconic wildlife adventure, featuring the spectacular in the Maasai Mara, combined with scenic lakes and breathtaking views of Mount Kilimanjaro in Amboseli. This group joining safari offers a perfect blend of wildlife, landscapes, and cultural encounters.

  • Maasai Mara National Reserve
  • The Great Migration (Seasonal): If traveling between July and October, witness the epic river crossings of millions of wildebeest and zebra across the Mara River.
  • Big Cat Sightings: The Mara is renowned for guaranteed sightings of lions, cheetahs, and leopards—it is one of the best places in the world to see predators in action.
  • Big Five & More: A near-certainty to spot the "Big Five" (lion, leopard, elephant, rhino, buffalo) and countless other species.
  • Hot Air Balloon Safari (Optional): Start your day with a breathtaking sunrise flight over the plains, followed by a champagne breakfast in the bush.
  • "Red" Elephants: The elephants here are famous for wallowing and dust-bathing in the rich red soil, giving them a distinctive crimson color.
  • Vast Open Wilderness: Experience the sheer scale of one of Kenya's oldest and largest parks, with its beautiful acacia woodlands and sweeping savannah.
  • Lake Naivasha

Day-by-day itinerary

01Day 1 | Nairobi – Maasai Mara National Reserve

Depart Nairobi in the morning and drive through the Great Rift Valley with scenic stopovers en route to the Maasai Mara. Arrive in time for lunch at your camp/lodge followed by an afternoon game drive. Dinner & Overnight: Maasai Mara

02Day 2 | Full Day Maasai Mara (Wildebeest Migration Experience)

Spend the entire day exploring the vast plains of the Maasai Mara, world-famous for the Great Migration . Witness thousands of wildebeests, zebras, and predators in action. Optional visit to a Maasai village. Maasai Mara Meals: Meals & Overnight:.

03Day 3 | Full Day Maasai Mara

Another exciting day in the reserve with morning and afternoon game drives. Search for the Big Five and enjoy close encounters with Africa’s iconic wildlife. Maasai Mara Meals: Meals & Overnight:.

04Day 4 | Maasai Mara – Lake Nakuru National Park

After breakfast, depart for Lake Nakuru National Park. Arrive in time for lunch followed by an afternoon game drive around the lake, famous for flamingos and rhinos. Dinner & Overnight: Nakuru

05Day 5 | Lake Nakuru – Lake Naivasha

Enjoy a morning game drive in Lake Nakuru National Park before proceeding to Lake Naivasha. Optional activities include a boat ride or walking safari at Crescent Island. Dinner & Overnight: Naivasha

06Day 6 | Lake Naivasha – Amboseli National Park

After breakfast, depart for Amboseli National Park via Nairobi. Arrive in the evening with views of Mount Kilimanjaro (weather permitting). Dinner & Overnight: Amboseli

07Day 7 | Full Day Amboseli National Park

Spend the day exploring Amboseli, known for its large elephant herds and stunning backdrop of Mount Kilimanjaro. Enjoy morning and afternoon game drives. Amboseli Meals: Meals & Overnight:.

08Day 8 | Amboseli – Nairobi

Early morning game drive followed by breakfast. Depart for Nairobi, arriving in the afternoon with drop-off at your hotel or airport. Please note that this safari is fully customizable to suit your travel preferences. You may choose to begin and end the tour in Nairobi, or start in Nairobi and finish in Mombasa if you plan to enjoy a beach extension along the Kenyan Coast. Our experienced Tour Consultants at Magical Africa Safaris are always ready to guide you and help tailor your trip for the best possible wildlife holiday experience.

What's included

  • Budget-friendly group joining safari
  • Game drives in custom 4x4 vehicles with expert guides

What's excluded

  • Soft drinks, alcoholic beverages, and snacks
  • Personal purchases or souvenirs
  • Optional activities (e.g., guided nature walks, cultural visits)
  • Tips and gratuities for driver/guide
  • Items of personal nature (e.g., jackets, binoculars, cameras)
  • Accommodation before or after the safari
  • Travel insurance or international medical cover

From-prices are planning figures for two adults sharing, in a private vehicle with a guide, at the season shown. Your written quote is the only price that applies. International flights, visas, tips, drinks and gorilla permits are separate unless the quote lists them.
